summary: BI-92804832 (EP-5F6369AB). Migration 20261113130000_relation_drift_repair makes every relation store use one spelling and one meaning: lower-case inventory/discovery relationship types become the registry key; the OS-host/Docker-host same-machine link (rule host_is_docker_host) is SAME_AS rather than RUNS_ON; product-to-product dependencies are projected into graph_edge; document references project as PROV-O / schema.org relations. Registers SAME_AS, CITES and SUPERSEDES.
affectedCopies: InventoryRelationship.relationshipType and DiscoveredRelationship.relationshipType: case-normalized in place; relationshipKey unchanged so discovery keeps matching rows; new writes normalized by discovery-normalize.ts
graph_edge: RUNS_ON same-machine edges retyped SAME_AS; ProductDependency rows projected as DEPENDS_ON / PART_OF; DOC_REFERENCES edges with a mapped refType retyped

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: infrastructure topology labels and product/document link types; no content changes.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Relation-type labels only; identifiers, keys and properties are unchanged.

migration.name: 20261113130000_relation_drift_repair
migration.backfill: In-place. Dry-run on the dev install on 2026-10-28 in a rolled-back transaction: 228 inventory and 872 discovered RUNS_ON rows became SAME_AS; 431 inventory and 11,830 discovered lower-case rows were normalized; 228 graph RUNS_ON edges were retyped; 54 product edges were added; 4 DOC_REFERENCES edges became USED. Afterwards every store held one spelling per type and no RUNS_ON or DOC_REFERENCES edge was left.
migration.rollback: Forward-only. The previous spellings are recoverable from relationshipKey, which still carries the collector's spelling.
